channel.title: Blow Your Mind
channel.desc: Dr Chris and Dr Xand bring you the top space experts on the planet to show you things that will truly Blow Your Mind! In this episode they find out all about super satellites and how they move around in space. Their friend and space expert Dr Maggie demonstrates how something as big as a satellite can stay in orbit around the Earth. And finally, Dr Maggie's off to see if she can spot the biggest satellite of all - the International Space Station - in the night sky.
